subject: Payee credentialing, PO handoff, and VAT evidence for Mendell Health
messages:
From: Lina Park <lina.park@mendellhealth.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@mendellhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Nov 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood vendor setup + PO mapping

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team was impressed. Our procurement team needs a few items to complete Redwood's vendor profile so we can issue purchase orders and route payments. Please see the checklist attached (Mendell_AP-Setup-Checklist.pdf). Key asks:

- Legal entity name and DBA (exact match to W9)
- Remit address and EFT details (if you accept ACH)
- VAT / tax jurisdiction and W9 (US entity)
- Standard PO template fields we must populate (attached: Mendell_PO_Template.xlsx)

Action: can you confirm whether Redwood can accept: ACH to Redwood Inc. (account on file) + remit email for payment remittance? Also we have a VAT withholding question: certain state-level clients apply backup withholding for vendors without a valid TIN on file. Please confirm whether the W9 you will provide shows Redwood's EIN.

If you prefer, we can provision Redwood in our portal and share an invite — that typically speeds approvals.

Thanks,
Lina
Mendell Health — Procurement

From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@mendellhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Nov 2028 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor setup + PO mapping

Hi Lina — thanks for the checklist and the clear template. Short answers below; full attachments coming from Finance:

- Legal entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (exact as on W9)
- Remit: we accept ACH (preferred) and wire. We will attach the standard Redwood remittance stub and bank details in a secure PDF.
- W9: we'll attach the completed W9 (Redwood_W9_2028.pdf) — EIN included, so backup withholding shouldn't apply.
- PO fields: we reviewed the Mendell_PO_Template.xlsx. We map PO number -> invoice header, remit email -> remittance@redwoodinference.com, and require the PO to be attached to the invoice PDF for automated matching.

Can you confirm if Mendell requires a specific invoice number prefix for cross-entity billing? Also — please add marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com (Finance) to the thread; he'll handle bank delivery and any secure upload you prefer.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@mendellhealth.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Nov 2028 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor setup + PO mapping

On Thu, Nov 1, 2028 at 12:05 PM Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi Lina — thanks for the checklist and the clear template. Short answers below; full attachments coming from Finance:
>
> - Legal entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (exact as on W9)
> - Remit: we accept ACH (preferred) and wire. We will attach the standard Redwood remittance stub and bank details in a secure PDF.

Hi Lina / Neha,

Looping in Marcus (Finance) as requested. Marcus — we will upload the W9 and a bank detail PDF; Mendell may ask us to submit via their vendor portal or to their secure SFTP. Lina, do you have a portal invite link you can send? If you provision us, please set the payment terms to Net 45 per the current SOW. Also, for automated PO matching we need the following PO fields populated exactly in Mendell's PO: vendor legal name, vendor ID (we can accept Mendell-assigned), and a clear delivery location code. If Mendell applies any state VAT withholding or backup withholding rules, confirm which jurisdiction so we can provide supporting tax certs.

Thanks,
Marissa
Head of Partnerships Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Roger Ellis <roger.ellis@procurement.mendellhealth.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Lina Park <lina.park@mendellhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Nov 2028 14:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor setup + PO mapping

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We can provision Redwood in our supplier portal; invite will go to remittance@redwoodinference.com (that email will be used for credentialing). A couple of clarifications from AP:

- Mendell's portal requires either an uploaded W9 (or W8 if foreign) and a signed ACH mandate form for bank accounts. We accept encrypted PDFs via the portal only.
- PO number prefix: for multi-entity billing please use prefix MH-<entity> (e.g., MH-RDWD) so our internal routing tags invoices correctly.
- VAT/withholding: Mendell applies withholding only for vendors without valid TINs at state level; because Redwood's W9 includes EIN we expect no backup withholding.

I'll send the portal invite to remittance@redwoodinference.com now. It will include a secure upload link and the ACH mandate template.

Roger
Senior Procurement Manager — Mendell Health

From: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Roger Ellis <roger.ellis@procurement.mendellhealth.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Nov 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor setup + PO mapping

Roger / Lina,

Appreciate the portal invite — I completed the upload of Redwood_W9_2028.pdf and the signed ACH mandate via the Mendell supplier portal (uploaded 2028-11-05). Notes for your AP automation team:

- File names uploaded: Redwood_W9_2028.pdf, Redwood_ACH-Mandate_Signed.pdf.
- Invoice formatting: we'll send invoices with header prefix "MH-RDWD" as requested; each invoice PDF will include the originating PO number and the Mendell-assigned vendor ID in the top-right for auto-matching.
- Remit email: remittance@redwoodinference.com — please whitelist for payment notifications.

If Mendell needs a separate tax residency declaration for any EU-subsidiary PO routing, let us know and we'll pull the certificate from Treasury.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Director, Finance — Redwood Inference
